summary: Frontend-only end-to-end UI testing for Bincycle. All 17 critical flows passed (marketing pages, nav, mobile hamburger, help search, contact form, privacy/terms, booking form including 7-day date window, time slot single-select, image upload+preview+clear, summary updates, submit gating, confirmation dialog, success screen with BC-#### id).

issues: Booking ID is regenerated via Math.random() on every render of the success view; if React re-renders the BC-#### number could change. Cosmetic but worth memoizing on confirm so the same id is shown to user/SMS.
Search input present and accepts text; could not verify FAQ filtering logic deeply but UI behaves; consider exposing data-testid on the search input for stability.

action_items: Minor: memoize the BC-#### booking id at the moment of confirmBooking() (e.g. useState + set on confirm) so the displayed booking number is stable across renders.
Minor: add a data-testid on the /help search input and individual FAQ items for easier regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: BookPickup.jsx: Math.floor(Math.random()*9000)+1000 sits in JSX of the success render, so any re-render reshuffles the booking id. Generate it once on confirm and store in state.
BookPickup.jsx: Calendar uses both fromDate/toDate AND disabled prop; redundant but harmless. Confirmed only 7 days (today..today+6) are enabled.
App.js: Toaster border uses moss green on near-black background — contrast OK. Brand palette consistent across pages.
MarketingNav.jsx: Mobile menu correctly closes on link click; aria-label present. Good.
mockData.js: Clean separation of mock data — good. All ids stable for testid usage.
test_credentials: Not applicable (mock user Aanya Rao, no auth)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only React app. Preview URL https://bincycle-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Booking flow data-testids: book-pickup-page, address-select-trigger, address-option-addr_{1..4}, address-selected-preview, date-picker-trigger, date-picker-calendar (react-day-picker uses button[name='day'] with .disabled attribute for blocked days — DO NOT use .rdp-day selector), timeslot-group, timeslot-ts{1..6}, notes-textarea, image-input, image-preview, image-clear-btn, summary-address/date/slot/photo, book-submit-btn, booking-confirm-dialog, confirm-cancel-btn, confirm-book-btn, booking-success, booking-new-btn. Marketing nav testids: marketing-nav, nav-link-{home/about/pricing/help/contact}, nav-book-pickup-cta, nav-mobile-toggle, nav-mobile-panel, nav-mobile-link-*. Date window verified: exactly 7 enabled day buttons (today..today+6).
rca_of_the_issue: No critical bugs found. All flows including the 7-day date window restriction, single-select time slot, image preview/clear, submit-disable gating, and confirmation→success screen with BC-#### id work as specified.
